id.description: Unique identifier for this decision (assigned by engine if omitted)

context.description: Decision context scope (item, non-item, wave, plan-closeup)

persist.description: Whether guidance persists across subsequent attempts

outlines.description: Decomposed item outlines when decision is split, or new/replacement item outlines when decision is amend (PlanItemOutline shape: slug, kind, title, description?, milestoneId?, deps?, etc.)

removeItemSlugs.description: Slugs of pending items to remove / supersede when decision is amend

outline.description: Item outline to schedule when decision is fix-item

debt.description: Technical debt description when decision is accept-with-debt

question.description: Specific question for human operator when decision is human-async or blocked

target.description: Corrected developer target from a merge-verify consult, applied to the merge verification instead of the record's stale target (unknown-gate recovery). One of {gate: <infra gate id>}, {selectors: [<test ids>]}, or {command, customTarget: true}.

planDelta.description: Plan delta or amendment directives when decision is amend

timestamp.description: ISO timestamp (assigned by engine if omitted)

concerns.description: Structured concerns raised by the architect

remarkable.description: Remarkable decisions or tradeoffs with the chosen option, alternatives, and why

concernConfirms.description: Architect confirmations for close-up concern resolutions

concernResolution.description: Direct concern resolution applied when the decision commits
